meta.title: Fix: Remove unnecessary async declarations from synchronous methods
meta.body_summary: Remove unnecessary async declarations from manager methods that contain no await, updating call sites and tests to improve code clarity and reduce coroutine overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Mechanical async removal across 9 files; bot review noted no functional issues, merged without human feedback.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 114 changed lines across 9 files, this is a small, purely mechanical refactor. It fits a low-risk code-clarity performance improvement that merged smoothly after a positive bot review.

review_details.concern_detail: Bot review suggested using exception chaining (raise ... from e) for better debugging across multiple manager classes.
review_details.performance_claim: Removing unnecessary async declarations eliminates coroutine overhead and improves code clarity.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Mechanical refactoring across multiple files to remove unnecessary async keywords; agent correctly updated call sites and test fixtures, bot review raised only code style nitpicks.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer (tpayet) authored the PR and presumably verified the changes; no explicit human feedback recorded. Coderabbit bot confirmed no functional issues.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No before/after performance measurement; only narrative claim of coroutine overhead removal.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions; PR merged without any fixes or issues.

core_change_summary.description: Removed async declarations from method signatures in all manager client classes (client, documents, indexes, keys, monitoring, settings, tasks) and server methods that contain no await, and updated call sites and test fixture accordingly.
change_trajectory: Single commit removed async keywords from 35 method signatures across 9 files and removed await at call sites in server.py and test_mcp_client.py.

review_signals.summary: Provided walkthrough of changes and suggested using exception chaining (`raise ... from e`) for better debugging in multiple files.

collaboration_trajectory: Human (tpayet) opened PR with agent-authored async removal changes.
Coderabbit bot reviewed within minutes, gave positive summary and nitpicks on exception chaining.
No human reviews or further comments; maintainer merged after ~66 hours.
